title.narrative: Identifying opportunities for Youth Empowerment and Climate Action in the Lutheran Youth Fellowship, Nigeria

description.narrative: The Partner Identification trip will take place in Nigeria, visiting the cities Abuja, Demsa, and Numan. The Danish project group, MAY Aarhus, will meet with the Lutheran Youth Fellowship (LYF), a youth organization within The Lutheran Church of Christ in Nigeria (LCCN). Both organizations share common values on youth empowerment, climate action, and social justice, making them strong potential partners. This trip aims to explore opportunities for collaboration between Nigerian and Danish youth by building relationships, learning about LYF�s ongoing initiatives and volunteerism within LYF, and identifying joint activities. MAY Aarhus and LYF will hold meetings and activities together to explore how youth from both countries can address challenges, particularly about environmental sustainability and community development. The outcome of the visit will be to identify a local project leader and engage volunteers to support future projects. Through the conversations and discussions, it also aims to draw up an agreement on the terms of the collaboration in form of a partnership agreement or Memorandum of understanding. By focusing on shared goals and engaging in joint activities, this trip will lay the groundwork for a long-term partnership and cross-cultural relationships between youth in Nigeria and in Denmark, promoting cultural exchange, empowerment and youth leadership in both countries.
